Name: Yoba 1.6 English translation
Author: gwrnori
Description:
It's the big man himself. Yoba is here and he is now in English. After 10,000 hours in notepad, now y'all can use it too.

Just download the file, unzip into the folder with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14871]the Original Mod [/url], let it overwrite the files and you should be good to go!

Only problem is that his home is behind the Cannoli statue in the Secret woods if you use Stardew Valley Expanded. I don't know how to fix that so you'll need to get a mod to get around that. Try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]noclip[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]let's move it[/url] or use chair magic.

He's god. You gotta work for it.

Mods in the images:
Portrait is from Nyapu
Event black bars
Vintage Interface v2
Earthy Recolor
